Question 3
?

Find the global extrema of the function f(x,y)=2xy+6x−3 on the closed region D enclosed by y=−x2 and y=−4. You are given that f has a critical point at (0,−3), and on the boundary of the region the points that could give rise to extreme values are (−2,−4), (−1,−1), (1,−1), and (2,−4).

a
fmin=−7 and fmax=1
b
fmin=−1 and fmax=7
c
fmin=−3 and fmax=7
d
fmin=−3 and fmax=1
e
fmin=−7 and fmax=7
